answer: A fleet gives itself away through its prose. Here, near-identical answers filed under different keys are merged into one voice: only the first is credited, the rest are buried under the dune they piled up. Each dawn an auditor samples pairs for copy-collision; quartz-hard clocks timestamp every submission, so a reworded clone still inherits its twin's quarantine. Cloning text is free; cloning genuinely distinct phrasing at scale is not.
